messages.subject: Re: Can I get 90% HPD?
messages.body_plain:
Seongho,

In the devel version, you can now obtain an HPD interval via

blavInspect(fit, "hpd", level=.9)

where "level" is the desired percentage.

Ed

On Wednesday, August 17, 2016 at 7:55:00 AM UTC-5, Ed Merkle wrote:
> Seongho,
>
> There is not currently a way to automatically obtain an HPD other than 95%. I will add this functionality soon.
>
> For now, you should be able to do this (assuming your fitted model is "fit" and that the coda package is loaded):
>
> HPDinterval(fit@external$runjags$mcmc, .9)
>
> But the parameter names there will not match the names from summary(). So it is not optimal.
>
> Ed

messages.subject: blavaan 0.2-1 is released on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
All,

blavaan 0.2-1 was released on CRAN yesterday. There are some minor changes so that blavaan works with the newest version of lavaan, and there is also some major restructuring of the internals. You may notice a difference if you export the JAGS code (it is hopefully easier to read now) or if you use equality constraints via "==" (general equality constraints are now possible, so long as only one parameter appears on the left side of '==').

I already know about a bug that crashes model estimation on Windows computers, so a fix for this will be forthcoming. Full list of new features here:

http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee/blavaan/version.html

Ed
